messages.common.messageUnavailable: Details are unavailable. Refresh to review the current information.
messages.error.loadingTitle: This view could not finish loading.
messages.error.connectionLost: The companion connection was lost. Your saved data has not been deleted. Reconnect to the companion and try again.
messages.error.notConfirmed: The operation was not confirmed. Your saved records remain available.
messages.settings.browserOnly: Appearance and language choices apply to this browser.
messages.settings.previewNotice: {name} preview uses English. Full translations are planned for a later checkpoint.
messages.settings.englishNotice: English is the source language. Scientific units and recorded UTC remain unchanged.
messages.settings.notSaved: Your choice applies to this tab. This browser could not save it for next time.
messages.dialog.unsavedWarning: Closing will discard the unsaved edits in this window. Saved data and ongoing operations will be preserved.
messages.components.emptyTitle: No saved data in this selection.
messages.settings.hostScope: Saved for this companion profile across restarts. Browser overrides stay in this browser. Units, scientific data and permissions are unchanged.
messages.settings.hostFollow: Use companion defaults in this browser
messages.settings.hostReadOnly: Companion defaults are read-only on paired devices. Change them on the companion PC.
messages.settings.hostUnavailable: Companion defaults are unavailable. Reconnect to review them; browser choices remain available.
messages.settings.hostSaved: Companion defaults saved. Reopen existing Windows dialogs to refresh their appearance. Other Windows dialog text remains English.
messages.settings.hostNativeNotice: The MSFS toolbar retains its readable dark appearance. Non-English choices are English previews, not complete translations.
messages.toolbar.catalogFallback: English fallback: the companion or catalog version is unavailable or incompatible.
messages.toolbar.catalogPreview: {name} preview uses bundled English; full translations are not available.
messages.home.intro: Choose your next step. Prepare a mission, record a flight, or review what you saved.
messages.home.resultsMeaning: These are saved flight records. Scientific evidence and limitations are checked in the original review.
messages.home.nextDetail.active: Open Current Flight to check science collection, add an observation or finish recording. Recording and science collection are separate.
messages.home.nextDetail.draft: Your unsaved edits are still in the planner in this browser. Review and save them before preparing a flight.
messages.home.nextDetail.plan: A saved mission plan is selected. Review its requirements in Current Flight. Recording starts only when you explicitly choose Start Recording.
messages.home.nextDetail.idle: Choose an experiment in Missions and review its setup. Simulator connection alone does not establish scientific readiness.
messages.home.nextDetail.connect: Open the companion on your PC and load a flight in MSFS. You can also prepare missions while disconnected.
messages.home.nextDetail.unavailable: Current activity could not be confirmed. Reconnect the companion or refresh status. No recording or science change has been requested.
messages.home.connection.stale: Simulator telemetry is out of date
messages.home.synthetic: SIMULATED TEST TELEMETRY — not an installed MSFS flight
messages.home.retained: Retained original observations: {original} · Derived observations: {derived} · Remote products: {products}. Counts do not establish scientific quality or completion.
messages.home.countsUnknown: Retained scientific counts are unavailable here. Open the original flight review to check evidence.
messages.home.stale: Activity is out of date or unavailable. Recording and science status are unconfirmed; reconnect or refresh before acting.
messages.home.telemetryWarning: Recording is confirmed by the companion, but current simulator input is unavailable or paused. Check Current Flight for collection holds and recovery.
messages.home.planUnavailable: The selected plan could not be loaded. Review the original selection in Current Flight; no unplanned flight was substituted.
messages.home.noPlan: No saved mission plan is selected.
messages.home.archiveAvailable: Archive available at the last successful check. Open a flight to review its exact saved scope.
messages.home.archiveEmpty: No saved flights to show yet. Choose a mission to begin.
messages.home.archiveUnavailable: The archive could not be checked. Saved results may still exist; reconnect and refresh to check availability.
messages.home.resultStatus.completed: Recording completed · science evidence requires review
messages.home.resultStatus.interrupted: Recording interrupted · review retained evidence and gaps
messages.home.noActiveCounts: Science collection starts separately from flight recording.
messages.home.collectionWarning: Science collection reports a hold or storage problem. New qualifying science is not confirmed. Open Current Flight to inspect the original status and recovery controls.
